lines.text: Many learners say: I like very much pizza.
Better: I like pizza very much.
Put very much at the end.
Very much! I like music very much.

data.why: Put very much at the end.

native.tip: Im Deutschen sagst du „Ich mag sehr Pizza“. Im Englischen steht „very much“ hinten.
native.caption: Zwischen Verb und Objekt darf nichts stehen! 🍕 Falsch: “I like very much pizza.” Richtig: “I like pizza very much.” Hör Ama zu und sprich nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.
native.comment: Lösung: “very much”. Richtig heißt es: “I like pizza very much.” Übe mehr mit einem kostenlosen Quiz: {link}

en.hook: Nothing can stand between the verb and the object!
en.tip: In English “very much” goes at the end, after the object.
en.caption: Nothing can stand between the verb and the object! Wrong: “I like very much pizza.” Right: “I like pizza very much.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
